title: 2022 avian influenza egg shortage
rootCause: HPAI, transport disruption or promotion oversell reduced available egg supply.

mitigationsApplied.action: Fair-share allocation, promotion cancellation and store limits
mitigationsApplied.outcome: Recovered shelf availability within one week.

lessonsLearned: Keep one visible traffic-driver SKU per store
notes: Historical precedent used by retrieval agents.
